Section 2.01 Restated Note. The terms, conditions, provisions, covenants, agreements,
warranties and privileges, including prepayment privileges, if any, contained in the Prior Notes
are hereby modified, amended and superseded in their entirety and restated as set forth in the
Note and the Loan Agreement and, as so modified, amended, restated and superseded are hereby
ratified, confirmed and approved by Mortgagor. The terms of the Note (modifying the Prior
Notes) apply to the entire amount of the Indebtedness. Mortgagor covenants and agrees to pay
the entire amount of the Indebtedness to Mortgagee as required by the Note and the Loan
Agreement. In any proceeding to enforce this Mortgage, Mortgagee shall be under no obligation
to produce, exhibit or demonstrate possession of the Prior Notes.
Section 2.02 Consolidation. Mortgagor and Mortgagee agree that the liens of the
Payee Mortgage and the liens of this Mortgage are hereby consolidated and coordinated so that
together they shall hereinafter constitute in law but one mortgage, a single lien securing the
principal sum of $85,500,000.00 and interest upon the Mortgaged Property.
Section 2.03 RestatedMortgage. The terms, conditions, provisions, covenants,
agreements, warranties and privileges, including prepayment privileges, if any, contained in the
Payee Mortgage are hereby modified, amended and superseded in their entirety and restated as
hereinafter set forth and, as so modified, amended, superseded and restated, are hereby ratified,
confirmed and approved by Mortgagor as set forth in this Mortgage. The terms of this Mortgage
(modifying the Payee Mortgage) apply to the entire amount of the Indebtedness. In any
proceeding to enforce this Mortgage, to the extent permitted by law, Mortgagee shall be under no
obligation to produce, exhibit or demonstrate the Payee Mortgage.
